    AI Overview
    Former Virginia Lieutenant Governor Justin Fairfax (2018–2022) faced severe sexual assault allegations in 2019 from two women, Vanessa Tyson and Meredith Watson, which derailed his political career. He denied the claims, alleging the encounters were consensual, and passed polygraph tests, but the scandal sparked resignation calls. 
    Key Allegations (2019): 
    • Vanessa Tyson: A professor who alleged that in 2004, Fairfax forced her to perform oral sex in a hotel room during the Democratic National Convention in Boston.
    • Meredith Watson: Alleged that Fairfax raped her in 2000 while they were both students at Duke University. 
    Fallout and Later Events: 
    • Political Impact: Fairfax refused to resign and finished his term, but the accusations effectively ended his rise, with a4th-place finish in the 2021 Democratic gubernatorial primary.
    • Murder-Suicide (April 2026): On April 16, 2026, police reported that Justin Fairfax killed his wife, Cerina Fairfax, and then himself at their Virginia home amid a "complicated" divorce.
